jina: Functions and powers of the Commission
maudhui: (1) The functions of the Commission shall be: (a) to advise the President on appointments of Judges of the High Court; (b) to advise the President on matters concerning discipline of Judges; (c) to advise the President on salaries and benefits of Judges; (d) to advise the President on appointment and discipline of the Registrar of the Court of Appeal and the Registrar of the High Court; (e) to appoint magistrates and supervise their discipline; and (f) to establish various committees for the performance of its functions. (2) The power to appoint, discipline and remove Judges from office shall vest in the President in accordance with this Constitution. (3) The power to appoint, confirm, discipline and remove from office the Registrars of the Court of Appeal and the High Court shall vest in the President. (4) The power to appoint, confirm, discipline and remove from office magistrates of courts in Mainland Tanzania shall vest in the Commission referred to in Article 112. (5) Parliament may enact a law prescribing provisions for the performance of the functions of the Commission.
